plan.promotion: Positive mean margin and at least 60 percent wins against lean20 and Euler28, no crashes or timeouts, zero losses against official starter; preserve every loss. Failure retains lean20 as the recommendation.
plan.retuning: No candidate tuning on validation. Any later hypothesis requires a separate study and new validation seeds.
plan.selection: Maximize the minimum opponent mean coin margin, then overall mean margin, then name; select before any validation games.

euler28.note: Seat-paired seed bootstrap; descriptive, not a multiple-selection-corrected guarantee.
